intent: 2D concept revision, no Unity or 3D changes

initial.prompt: Duck Rails production CONCEPT revision. Match the approved low-poly game-render look: broad flat polygon surfaces, very visibly coarse pixel textures painted on simple meshes, teal/ivory train paint, amber fixtures, economical geometry. Not photorealistic, not voxel brick construction, not watercolor. These are 2D concept illustrations, not built models. Keep mostly open-air roofless crew deck and only small front cockpit roof. ALL these changes supersede older reference details: exactly ONE larger furnace INBOARD within the rear-left of the front cockpit, tucked behind and to left of central driving seat, NOT mounted against exterior side rail or on crew deck edge. A THICK vertical smokestack connects directly to top of this furnace and exits above cockpit roof. Furnace only has ONE square fire/coal insertion opening on its AFT face toward crew deck, about 0.5 x 0.5 metres. All side/front faces CLOSED solid dark metal, no extra glowing fire windows. No coal bins, coal piles, loose coal chunks, buckets of coal or coal decorative props anywhere. Show a few stylized smoke particle puffs from thick stack in motion preview only. One centered LOW SEAT at front-middle of cockpit. Dash directly in front of seat carries physical throttle lever, maintain low forward view at about 0.5m eye height above deck; short thin low dash, no towering hood. One front-facing HEADLIGHT at front center shining onto track, keep two side-mounted amber lamps LEFT and RIGHT of cockpit. NO pendant/ceiling/hanging light inside cockpit. Radio table retained train-right just behind cockpit: redesigned simplified teal/off-white rectangular speaker box, only a large FLAT pixel-textured grille, absolutely no modeled knobs or buttons/dials on RADIO. Separate short upright microphone with angular capsule head, simple base and ONE obvious amber HOLD TO TALK button on bottom/base facing user. This mic-base button is the only physically interactive radio-station control. The user's reference is inspiration not copied retro device. No decorative raised controls on radio; optional markings flat in texture only. Bags at right rear, gear shelf at left rear, clear opposed middle boarding gaps, open central deck. Create one wide landscape revised turnaround sheet with exactly FOUR panels: large LEFT SIDE elevation upper left, TOP PLAN upper right with front at left, FRONT elevation lower left, three-quarter exterior lower right. Short title 'DUCK RAILS / TRAIN REVISION 2', subtitle 'PROVISIONAL DESIGN'. All four views must depict SAME train with CONSISTENT positions. Hero exterior in bottom-right sees front left; furnace aft-facing opening may be hidden in front views, do NOT add an exterior-facing opening to make fire visible. Left side should show ONLY CLOSED furnace side directly below the ONE THICK STACK, no firebox on side railing, no second furnace, no extra stovepipes. Top plan place centered seat near front window, low throttle dash ahead of seat, single inboard furnace behind-left of seat (when facing forward), its single mouth aimed toward open deck behind, table on train-right behind cockpit. Headlight directly on front-center just below window illuminates tracks. Show no roof pendant lamps whatsoever, just outside left/right cockpit lamps. Keep unoccupied seat clearly visible in top plan, no characters needed. Lower-right exterior shows long open deck and wide side entrances, retain compact silhouette. Radio in all views is plain grille-only speaker box with separate simple mic/base, no red retro complex device. Broad neutral charcoal studio backdrop and even illustration lighting for inspection. Sparse labels only 'SEAT', 'THROTTLE', 'ONE FURNACE + STACK', 'HEADLIGHT', 'RADIO TABLE'. Do not write dimensions or generate technical arrows. Avoid making furnace coal mouth visible on several faces; maintain one aft-facing aperture.
